name: Use Composition API for new projects
guideline: Use Composition API for new projects
description: Composition API offers better TypeScript support and logic reuse

name: Use ref for primitives
description: ref() for primitive values that need reactivity

name: Use reactive for objects
description: reactive() for complex objects and arrays
do: reactive() for objects with multiple properties

name: Access ref values with .value
description: Remember .value in script unwrap in template

name: Use computed for derived state
description: Computed properties cache and update automatically

name: Use watchEffect for simple cases
dont: watch with explicit deps when not needed

name: Use watch for specific sources
description: Explicit control over what to watch

name: Avoid mutating props
do: Emit events to parent for changes

name: Avoid onBeforeMount for data
description: Use onMounted or setup for data fetching

name: Return refs from composables
dont: Return reactive objects that lose reactivity

name: Accept ref or value params
dont: Only accept ref or only value

name: Avoid v-if with v-for
description: v-if has higher priority causes issues
do: Wrap in template or computed filter
dont: v-if on same element as v-for

name: Use key with v-for
dont: Index as key for dynamic lists

name: Test component behavior
do: Test props emit and rendered output

name: Bind aria attributes dynamically
description: Keep ARIA in sync with state
